heading: Weekly Current Affairs
subheading: Uploaded every Sunday as a Weekly Gist. Each headline includes short context and analysis for UKPSC exams. Latest week appears on top.

items.title: Uttarakhand approved as a 'Fully Literate State'
items.context: The state was declared fully literate under the ULLAS / New India Literacy Programme — a significant milestone in achieving adult-literacy targets and improving human-development indicators.

items.title: Cabinet clears ₹1.11 lakh crore Budget for FY 2026-27; 28 proposals approved
items.context: The state Cabinet cleared the annual budget along with 28 proposals in a single sitting, signalling the government's spending and welfare priorities for the year.

items.title: Uniform Civil Code, Uttarakhand (Amendment) Bill, 2026 sanctioned
items.context: Refines Uttarakhand's UCC — the first such state law in India. High relevance for Polity & Governance answers on state legislative competence.

items.title: Kumbh Mela 2027 (Haridwar): Cabinet delegates enhanced financial powers
items.context: Enhanced financial powers were delegated to speed up preparations for the 2027 Haridwar Kumbh — a major event-management and infrastructure exercise.

items.title: UKPSC Rules, 2026 amended by State Cabinet
items.context: Amendments to the recruitment and examination rules of the Uttarakhand Public Service Commission — directly relevant for aspirants tracking the exam framework.

items.title: Voluntary/Partial Consolidation (Chakbandi) Promotion Policy, 2026 for hill districts
items.context: Encourages voluntary land consolidation in the hills to counter fragmented and scattered land holdings, a long-standing constraint on hill agriculture.

items.title: Char Dham Yatra 2026 repeatedly disrupted by landslides and heavy rain
items.context: Monsoon landslides and cloudbursts repeatedly disrupted the pilgrimage, highlighting the fragility of hill roads and disaster-preparedness themes.

items.title: Advanced Apple Nursery Development Scheme 2026 and Honey Production Policy 2026 approved
items.context: Horticulture and beekeeping push aimed at strengthening hill livelihoods and diversifying farm incomes.

items.title: Bal Palash Yojana (Child Nutrition Campaign) expanded
items.context: The child-nutrition campaign was scaled up to improve maternal and child health indicators in the state.

items.title: Equine insurance cover for pilgrimage-route horses and mules
items.context: Insurance cover introduced for horses and mules used on yatra routes — a welfare measure for animals and the porters who depend on them.

items.title: Center for Aromatic Plants renamed Perfumery & Aromatic R&D Institute
items.context: Upgrades the Center for Aromatic Plants (CAP) into a research and development institute, supporting the state's aroma economy.

items.title: Excise and motor vehicle rule amendments: VAT raised to 65%
items.context: A revenue measure raising VAT on liquor to 65%, alongside motor-vehicle rule changes.

items.title: One-time relaxation for Statehood Movement activists' reservation claims
items.context: A one-time relaxation eases reservation claims for statehood-movement activists (andolankaris), a recurring policy and legal issue in the state.

items.title: Monsoon Session of Parliament 2026 begins (20 July – 13 August)
items.context: A 19-sitting session with key bills and reports scheduled, including debate on major legislative business.

items.title: Union Cabinet approves Mobile Phone Manufacturing Scheme & Semicon 2.0
items.context: Aims to deepen domestic electronics and semiconductor manufacturing under the broader Make-in-India and self-reliance push.

items.title: Cabinet approves National Investment Policy for Urea (NIPU-2026)
items.context: Policy to encourage investment in domestic urea capacity, reducing import dependence in fertilisers.

items.title: Cabinet approves railway multitracking projects in Odisha and Jharkhand
items.context: Capacity-expansion projects to ease freight and passenger congestion on key eastern rail corridors.

items.title: Anurag Jain appointed CEO of NITI Aayog
items.context: A key administrative appointment — useful for the 'Persons in News' and governance sections.

items.title: Ajit Doval selected for Lokmanya Tilak National Award 2026
items.context: Awards and honours item; note the awardee and the award's association with Tilak's legacy.

items.title: 16th BRICS Health Ministers' Meeting held in Chandigarh
items.context: India hosted the BRICS health ministerial, reinforcing multilateral cooperation on public health.

items.title: Tri-Service all-women circumnavigation 'Samudra Pradakshina' concludes
items.context: A tri-service all-women expedition concluded — relevant for defence, women-empowerment and 'in news' themes.

items.title: Ministry of I&B launches 'Gems of India' Challenge on MyWAVES
items.context: A creative/cultural challenge on the MyWAVES platform promoting Indian content and creators.

items.title: RBI keeps repo rate unchanged at 5.25%; GDP forecast trimmed to 6.6%
items.context: The monetary policy committee held rates steady while slightly lowering the growth forecast — key economy data points.

items.title: Vikram-1 (Mission Aagaman): India's first private orbital launch
items.context: A milestone in India's private space sector, marking the first private orbital launch.

items.title: NITI Aayog releases 'Unlocking Growth in Tourism & Hospitality' report
items.context: Policy report identifying reforms to expand tourism and hospitality's contribution to GDP and jobs.

items.title: Supreme Court flags use of AI-hallucinated case law in judicial orders
items.context: The Court cautioned against citing fabricated, AI-generated case law — a notable intersection of technology and the judiciary.

items.title: MY Bharat launches 'Viksit Bharat Yuva Connect Programme'
items.context: A youth-engagement initiative under the MY Bharat platform aligned with the Viksit Bharat vision.

items.title: US–Iran conflict: temporary pause in strikes, Strait of Hormuz tensions
items.context: A fragile pause amid tensions around the Strait of Hormuz — critical for global oil supply and India's energy security.

items.title: France becomes first EU nation to ban social media for under-15s
items.context: A landmark child-safety regulation likely to shape EU-wide debates on social-media access for minors.

items.title: President Murmu unveils Mahatma Gandhi bust in North Macedonia
items.context: Cultural diplomacy item during the President's overseas engagements.

items.title: Saudi–Houthi hostilities escalate on the Red Sea coast
items.context: Escalation affecting Red Sea shipping routes, with implications for global trade and freight costs.

items.title: International Criminal Court votes to remove its chief prosecutor
items.context: A rare institutional move at the ICC — relevant for international-organisations coverage.

items.title: Wildfires in France and Spain disrupt Tour de France
items.context: Climate-linked wildfires disrupted a major sporting event, underlining the extreme-weather theme.

items.title: PM Modi welcomes Japanese PM Sanae Takaichi on first India visit
items.context: A high-level India–Japan engagement; note the visiting leader and bilateral significance.

items.title: US tariff escalation continues under President Trump
items.context: Continued tariff actions with implications for global trade and Indian exports.

items.title: Berlin Pride event disrupted by attack
items.context: A security incident at a major public event in Germany.

items.title: EU moves toward bloc-wide child social-media access framework
items.context: Follows France's move, signalling a possible EU-wide standard on minors' social-media access.

items.title: 16th BRICS Health Ministerial Declaration adopted
items.context: The health ministerial adopted a joint declaration on cooperation in public health among BRICS nations.

items.title: India's space economy: USD 8.4B (2026) → projected USD 100B by 2040
items.context: Growth projection underscoring India's expanding role in the global space economy.

items.title: Barack Obama Presidential Center opens in Chicago
items.context: A notable international culture/institutions item.

items.title: Badrinath donation-theft case: SIT arrests accused Pramod Nautiyal
items.context: The state SIT arrested an accused in the alleged theft of donations from the Badrinath temple collection box and produced him in court. CM Dhami had earlier called tampering with temple offerings a grave offence.

items.title: Fresh red/yellow alerts as monsoon rain lashes the state
items.context: IMD issued a yellow alert for Dehradun and four other districts after days of red alerts; Char Dham Yatra routes remained affected by landslides and rising river levels in Garhwal and Kumaon.

items.title: 107 roads shut, 7 districts on red alert
items.context: Continuous rain disrupted traffic on 107 routes including 9 state highways and a BRO road. Kashipur recorded the season's highest rainfall (206mm).

items.title: Char Dham Yatra continues despite cloudbursts and landslides
items.context: Over 4.4 lakh devotees registered for Yatra 2026; daily footfall was recorded across Badrinath, Kedarnath, Gangotri, Yamunotri and Hemkund Sahib despite heavy monsoon disruption.

items.title: Green Card now mandatory for hill-route passenger vehicles
items.context: Authorities directed that no passenger vehicle to Chopta, Char Dham or other hill destinations be allowed on mountain roads without a valid Green Card, citing road safety.

items.title: Four tourists killed after car plunges into gorge near Mussoorie
items.context: A car reportedly lost control on the Mussoorie–Dehradun road and fell nearly 500 metres into a gorge near Kolhukhet, killing all four occupants.

items.title: CM Dhami intervenes in Delhi hotel-fire arrest case
items.context: CM Pushkar Singh Dhami intervened regarding the arrest of an Uttarakhand resident connected to the fatal Malviya Nagar hotel fire in south Delhi.

items.title: Rispana and Kali rivers rise sharply amid heavy rain
items.context: Dehradun's Rispana river and Pithoragarh's border Kali river saw continuously rising water levels; the Mandakini and Alaknanda in Garhwal were under close monitoring.

items.title: Bareilly–Haldwani Greenfield Expressway construction begins
items.context: Work started on a new 100km four-lane expressway expected to cut travel time to the Uttarakhand foothills by over three hours.

items.title: Chamoli avalanche stays clear of main road, no disruption
items.context: The District Magistrate confirmed an avalanche in Chamoli did not reach the main road; traffic and daily life in the area remained unaffected.

items.title: Parliament's Monsoon Session set for 20 July – 13 August
items.context: A 19-sitting, 25-day session was announced. The JPC report on the 130th Constitution Amendment Bill (removal of arrested officials) was expected on 17 July.

items.title: Gujarat HC upholds convictions in 2008 Ahmedabad bomb blasts
items.context: The High Court upheld the conviction of 49 people (38 death sentences, 11 life terms) in the 2008 serial-bombing case.

items.title: Centre names 23 Jaish/LeT operatives as terrorists
items.context: The government designated 23 operatives of Jaish-e-Mohammed and Lashkar-e-Taiba as terrorists, citing links to a Jammu & Kashmir attack.

items.title: New rural employment guarantee law replaces MGNREGA nationwide
items.context: A new rural employment guarantee law came into force from 1 July, with the Centre releasing a first tranche of ₹25,863 crore to states for implementation.

items.title: Air Marshal Ashutosh Dixit named 51st Vice Chief of Air Staff
items.context: Air Marshal Ashutosh Dixit assumed charge as the new Vice Chief of the Air Staff on 1 July 2026.

items.title: Magnitude 4.2 earthquake hits Maharashtra
items.context: A moderate earthquake damaged around 105 houses, prompting local damage assessments.

items.title: India proposes anti-narcotics working group at BRICS meet
items.context: At a BRICS anti-drug meeting in Guwahati, India proposed a virtual working group on narcotics trafficking among member nations.

items.title: Madhya Pradesh reorganises Waqf Board under new Act
items.context: MP reconstituted its state Waqf Board — including two Hindu members — becoming the first state to do so under the Waqf (Amendment) Act, 2025.

items.title: CPM urges Centre to bring Ram Temple Trust under RTI
items.context: The CPM pressed the central government to bring the Ram Janmabhoomi Trust under the Right to Information Act for greater transparency.

items.title: Delhi hotel-fire arrest widens; Uttarakhand link probed
items.context: Investigation continued into the Malviya Nagar (south Delhi) hotel fire that killed 21 people, with the arrest of an Uttarakhand-resident suspect drawing political attention.

items.title: FIFA World Cup 2026: Semifinal lineup complete
items.context: France, Spain, England and Argentina reached the semifinals; the final was scheduled for 19 July in New Jersey.

items.title: US–Iran ceasefire strain: renewed strikes reported
items.context: The US and Iran exchanged fresh strikes after their ceasefire frayed, reviving fears of a wider regional war.

items.title: Trump meets Zelenskyy at NATO summit in Turkey
items.context: President Trump held talks with Ukraine's President Zelenskyy on the sidelines of a NATO summit, agreeing to license Ukraine to manufacture Patriot air-defence systems.

items.title: Mourners bid farewell to Iran's late Supreme Leader
items.context: Large crowds gathered in Karbala and Tehran to mourn Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, with his successor now leading amid regional tension.

items.title: Deadly pub fire in Bangkok
items.context: A large fire tore through a pub in northern Bangkok, killing several people.

items.title: Shooting at Latin-culture festival in Toronto
items.context: At least two people died and four were injured in a shooting at the 'Salsa on St. Clair' festival in Toronto.

items.title: Venezuela earthquake recovery: tens of thousands still missing
items.context: Rescue hopes faded over a week after quakes damaged more than 58,000 buildings; the UN warned of hunger and disease risk among displaced survivors.

items.title: FIFA weighs expanding World Cup to 64 teams for 2030
items.context: FIFA president Gianni Infantino confirmed discussions on expanding the men's World Cup from 48 to 64 teams from 2030.

items.title: Argentina reach World Cup semifinal via dramatic extra time
items.context: Julian Alvarez's long-range strike sent defending champions Argentina past Switzerland and into the semifinals in Kansas City.

items.title: FIFA–FIFPRO talks on heat-safety rules for matches
items.context: FIFA and the global players' union FIFPRO discussed protocols to avoid matches being played in excessive heat after several World Cup games saw extreme conditions.
